description: Muse Music v1.0.7 brings synchronized Listen Together rooms with muse.abhiyank.in links, direct link sharing, and reliable real-time group song playback.

changelog.title: Listen Together (Group Song Sync)
items: Synchronized group listening sessions compatible with Muse Web (https://muse.abhiyank.in/colab?room=...)
Direct invite link generation and sharing formatted for the Muse web ecosystem
Deep link auto-joining: tapping room links opens the app and joins the group session immediately
Smart room code parser: accepts full invite links, /colab/ or /listen/ URLs, and 6-8 character codes
Switched to active high-availability WebSocket sync server (devilmi-vivi-music-listen-together.hf.space)
Reliable RFC 6455 Text-frame WebSocket communication for real-time play, pause, seek, and track sync

changelog.title: Fixes & Stability
items: Fixed WebSocket payload serialization rejecting binary frames on JSON servers
Expanded room code validator to support all 6-8 character alphanumeric codes across screens
Optimized deep link routing and room joining in MainActivity
